note: keys are the dimension names the model emits; paper_names are the formal names used in the paper

Depth perception.1: Unable to judge depth accurately, frequent adjustments of instrument position required. Constantly off target with large movements and slow correction.
Depth perception.2: Occasionally able to judge depth but still requires frequent adjustment.
Depth perception.3: Sometimes able to judge depth accurately but occasional adjustment needed. Slightly off target but corrects quickly.
Depth perception.4: Usually judges depth accurately with minimal adjustment.
Depth perception.5: Consistently judges depth accurately with smooth operation. Guides instrument precisely to the target plane.

Bimanual coordination.1: Very poor coordination, frequent lack of control. Uses one hand and neglects the non-dominant hand with poor coordination.
Bimanual coordination.2: Occasionally uses both hands but with noticeable lack of coordination.
Bimanual coordination.3: Mostly coordinates both hands but occasionally lacks synchronization. Uses both hands but does not optimize their interaction.
Bimanual coordination.4: Almost always coordinates both hands well with minimal lack of synchronization.
Bimanual coordination.5: Consistently coordinates both hands smoothly. Skillfully uses both hands to provide optimal exposure.

Efficiency.1: Very inefficient with frequent wasted time. Uncertain and ineffective efforts with many exploratory movements and shifting focus without progress.
Efficiency.2: Sometimes inefficient with occasional wasted time.
Efficiency.3: Mostly efficient but occasionally slow. Movements are deliberate and organized.
Efficiency.4: Almost always efficient with rare inefficiency.
Efficiency.5: Consistently efficient with no wasted time. Confident, effective, safe, and focused on the task.

Tissue handling.1: Rough tissue handling with frequent damage. Tears tissue, injures nearby structures, and/or several episodes of instrument slippage occurred.
Tissue handling.2: Occasionally rough tissue handling causing some damage.
Tissue handling.3: Generally good tissue handling but occasionally rough. Handles tissue appropriately with minor trauma to adjacent tissue.
Tissue handling.4: Almost always good tissue handling with minimal roughness.
Tissue handling.5: Consistently gentle and precise tissue handling with no damage. Handles tissue well with minimal injury to surrounding structures.
